On the `/debug/states/finalized` (note pr moving this also) endpoint, it'd be nice to have consistent behaviour pre-genesis...
Some nodes give 500, some return genesis state... i think returning genesis state is an ideal scenario... Can we maybe look at being consistent on this pre-genesis behaviour?
Another example, currently holesky thats running is not finalized so /finalized is still returning genesis from teku for example...
